decisions.rationale: Contract-only SG-SPEC-0064 obligation: Groups spec refinement/linkage policy, reflective governance and graph-health signals, ubiquitous vocabulary primitives, and project ontology context selection without redefining the bounded contracts owned by those children. The reviewed Supervisor candidate prepares this specification; this PR changes no production Python/Rust/Swift/shell code and claims no implementation or semantic approval.
